Closer look

The modules teams lean on most

A deeper look at the four capabilities that tend to save the most time once switched on.

Payroll

Payroll that runs itself

Salary structures, tax slabs, and statutory deductions are configured once — every cycle after that is automatic.

  • Auto-calculated gross-to-net pay, including bonuses and deductions
  • PF, ESI, professional tax, and TDS computed and filed on schedule
  • Digital payslips delivered directly to the employee portal
  • Full audit trail for every payroll run

Attendance

Attendance without the arguments

Multiple check-in methods feed one source of truth, so disputes over hours worked become rare.

  • Biometric, mobile geo-tagged, and web check-in options
  • Automatic overtime, late-arrival, and shortfall calculations
  • Shift-aware rostering with real-time conflict alerts
  • Direct sync into payroll — no manual re-entry

Performance

Reviews people actually engage with

Goal-tracking and feedback happen continuously, not just once a year in a rushed appraisal cycle.

  • OKR / KPI goal-setting cascaded from company to individual level
  • 360° feedback from managers, peers, and direct reports
  • Structured appraisal cycles with calibrated ratings
  • Performance history tied to promotions and compensation reviews

Self-service

An HR portal employees actually use

Most routine HR requests never need to reach a person — the portal handles them directly.

  • Apply for leave, view balances, and track approval status
  • Download payslips, tax forms, and compliance documents
  • Update personal details and emergency contacts
  • Raise and track HR helpdesk tickets end to end

Frequently Asked Questions About Our HRMS

What is an HRMS?

A Human Resource Management System (HRMS) is software that helps businesses manage employee data, attendance, leave, payroll, recruitment, performance, and other HR processes from a centralized platform.

What are the benefits of using an HRMS?

An HRMS automates repetitive HR tasks, reduces paperwork, improves data accuracy, enhances compliance, saves time, and provides real-time insights for better workforce management.

Can an HRMS automate attendance and leave management?

Yes. Most modern HRMS platforms automatically track employee attendance, manage leave requests, calculate leave balances, and generate reports, reducing manual administrative work.

Is an HRMS suitable for small businesses?

Yes. An HRMS is beneficial for businesses of all sizes. Small businesses can streamline HR operations, improve employee record management, and save valuable time as their workforce grows.

Can an HRMS integrate with payroll and other business software?

Yes. Many HRMS solutions integrate with payroll systems, accounting software, biometric attendance devices, ERP platforms, and recruitment tools to create a seamless HR workflow.

How does an HRMS improve employee management?

An HRMS centralizes employee information, automates routine processes, tracks performance, simplifies communication, and provides managers with actionable insights to make informed workforce decisions.
